description:
**Surfaced 2026-05-17 by user-tier POLYBIUS during end-of-session hygiene audit.**

The-stoa workspace root currently has 14+ tracked HUMAN_paste-*.md files from arcs 21 / 23 / 24 / 25 / 26 / 27 / 28 / 29 / 30 / 31 (each typically has a pliny variant + a polybius variant; arc-27 onward have both). New ones accumulate every arc dispatch. No archival or cleanup convention exists.

## Observable symptom

`ls HUMAN_paste-*.md` at workspace root shows a growing list that includes paste files for arcs long-since-shipped-and-closed. The directory listing degrades as a navigational surface. Future POLYBIUSes have no convention for distinguishing 'paste file from the arc I am about to dispatch' from 'paste file from arc 21 shipped weeks ago.'

## Fix-shape options (operator picks)

1. **Archive on arc close:** at arc-N close, PLINY moves `HUMAN_paste-{polybius,pliny}-arc-N-instruction.md` from workspace root to a substrate/arcs/<N>/pastes/ subdirectory (parallel to the existing substrate/arcs/arc-N-build-directive.md location). Workspace root stays clean; historical pastes still accessible via the arcs/ tree.

2. **Delete on arc close:** at arc-N close, PLINY deletes the paste files from workspace root. Historical pastes recoverable via git history if ever needed. Most aggressive cleanup.

3. **Leave + accept:** acknowledge the accumulation as feature not bug (historical record at workspace root, immediately visible). Document the pattern in MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md as expected.

DAEDALUS picks during build. Option 1 has the cleanest separation (parallel to existing arc-directive archival pattern); Option 2 is simplest; Option 3 is null-op.

## Out of scope

- Migration of existing paste files (one-time backfill is a separate consideration; the ongoing-convention question is what this ticket is about)
- HUMAN_paste-orchestrator-instruction.md (the default non-arc paste; refreshed in place by install.sh; not arc-scoped; stays at root)

## Cross-refs

- substrate/arcs/ (the existing arc-N-build-directive.md archival pattern that Option 1 would extend)
- MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md §4.5 (durable-substrate-with-short-prompts pattern that authorizes the on-disk paste files in the first place)

## Why P4

Cosmetic; no operational impact. Workspace works fine with current accumulation. Fix-shape is small but not urgent.
title: HUMAN_paste-arc-N-instruction.md accumulation at workspace root — archival convention needed
